mapper.select: SELECT b.schedule_id ,c.sche_week ,c.sche_day ,TO_CHAR(c.sched_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as sched_date ,c.sche_method ,c.sched_time ,c.sche_seq FROM members a ,schedule_creation b ,schedule_details c WHERE a.mem_id = b.mem_id AND b.schedule_id = c.schedule_id AND a.mem_id = #{memId} AND b.use_yn ='Y' ORDER BY c.sche_seq
